title: Delicate and pretty copper wire
text: Delicate and pretty copper wire. Plan on putting in my den when it’s painted. They are very delicate, like all the different settings they have.

product_metadata.title: koopower 2X 50 LEDs Battery Fairy Lights with Timer on 16ft Waterproof Copper String for Outdoor, Incl. Remote (Dim+-, 8 Modes), Warm White
features: Timer and Memory Function: KooPower 2 Pack 50 LEDs battery fairy lights can be used indoors or outdoors without trailing cables or an external power supply. The timing program (6H on, 18H off) dispels your worries about forgetting to turn off the lights, Memory function spares you from resetting the mode next time

Waterproof and Flexible: Dustproofing and waterproofing to IP65 level make these light and suitable for use in conditions where dust, rain, spraying water, snow or frost is likely. With thin and flexible silver wire mounted in, the string lights can be easily twisted into any shape you like. Style them in clear jars, vases, wine bottles, lanterns, wrap-around potted plants, Christmas trees, wreaths, etc.

Remote Control: Without even a move, you’re in full control of the twinkle lights. The remote enables you to achieve a fast conversion of different modes and settings with the one-hand operation(Attention: The remote should be faced the signal receiver - in the front of the control box.)by pressing the brightness "+" and "-", you can adjust the brightness.

Variable Modes: 8 blinking modes (Combination, Steady on, Slow fade, In waves, Slo Glo, Chasing/Flash, Sequential, Twinkle/Flash) and brightness setting provide a perfect solution to your decorative needs.
Perfect for Decoration: use at Christmas, Easter, Halloween, Thanksgiving other celebration events or simply to room decor to give your home a novel warm inviting glow.
